jobs.description:
As a part-time mail carrier for PostNL in Overloon, you make sure everyone receives their mail on time. This job offers plenty of flexibility, as you can organize your working hours yourself.

Your day starts at the depot at the Baasestraat in Overloon, where you collect the mail for your delivery route. After sorting the letters, you hop on your bike and set off. You cycle through the streets of Overloon, delivering mail to the correct addresses. Along the way, you can enjoy the fresh air and have a chat with the people you meet.

We currently have a vacancy in Overloon for approximately 3 hours per day, from Tuesday through Saturday, totaling around 15 hours per week.

You can collect your mail from around 10:00 AM, and you are free to decide when to start your route, as long as all mail is delivered before 6:00 PM. This gives you the freedom to fit the job around your schedule.

Are you 16 years or older, do you speak Dutch or English, and do you enjoy working outdoors? Then apply now and soon you'll be delivering letters and cards throughout one of our local neighborhoods!

Anyone aged 16 and over can become a mail carrier. You understand that you are the face of the postal company and therefore work accurately and in a customer-friendly manner. You enjoy being outdoors, staying active, and working independently. As a mail carrier, you like being on the move and take pride in delivering mail that makes people happy.

What you need:

- A smartphone that you can use during work for communication and route planning;
- A sturdy bicycle with a metal luggage rack;
- Availability for approximately 3 hours per day, either in the morning or afternoon;
- Flexibility to agree on a work schedule that suits both you and the employer.

As a logistics employee, you handle incoming and outgoing goods every day. You unpack and check products, and prepare them for shipment. You also ensure the warehouse remains tidy and organized. You work with scanners and sometimes a forklift. Working hours are flexible, and you can work either full-time or part-time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that customers receive their orders on time. You need to work in 3 shifts; morningshift (7:00-15:30), afternoonshift (15:00-23:30) and nightshift (23:00-7:30). 

You are someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys working as part of a team. You value completing tasks neatly and on time. You are capable of working accurately and have no trouble standing or walking during your shift. You have a reasonable command of spoken and written English, enabling effective communication within the team. Logistics experience is a plus but not a requirement—you are a quick learner!

Mandatory requirements:

- You have at least a VMBO level of education/aptitude
- You speak and write English
- You live within 20 km of Lelystad

As a Maintenance Handyman, you will make sure our warehouse, facilities and surrounding areas are kept safe, functional and well-maintained.

Your tasks will include:

- Carrying out small repairs and maintenance jobs throughout the company.
- Repairing and maintaining lockers, doors and other facilities.
- Helping to keep the warehouse and surrounding grounds in good condition.
- Identifying maintenance issues and solving them where possible.
- Supporting colleagues with various practical tasks.

Every day is different, so you won't be sitting behind a desk. It's an active and varied job where you are constantly on the move and working with your hands.

We are looking for someone who:

- Is practical and enjoys fixing and making things.
- Has basic technical knowledge and is comfortable using tools.
- Is proactive and can work independently.
- Is reliable and takes pride in their work.
- Enjoys an active working environment.
- Can communicate in English, Spanish or Romanian.
- Previous experience in maintenance, construction, facility services or a similar role is a plus, but not required.

As part of a dynamic warehouse team, you will help ensure that packages are processed efficiently and delivered on time.

- Hourly rate: €16.50

Amazon is one of the world's largest e-commerce and technology companies, serving millions of customers globally.
